request.user:
Question: handmade candle ecommerce mobile app browsing filters checkout patterns
Topic: common features and design patterns of similar mobile apps

response.text:
Similar candle-shopping apps and storefronts commonly organize browsing around scent/fragrance, product type, season, and price. Search and filters help shoppers narrow options; scent notes, mood descriptions, product stories, and clear size-specific pricing and images support choosing without smelling the candle in person. Some designs add a scent quiz, wishlists, product recommendations, or quick add-to-cart. ([sarahross.ca](https://www.sarahross.ca/work/good-vibes?utm_source=openai))

Product pages may show safety and allergen information, reviews, and gifting options such as gift wrap and a message. Checkout patterns described include a shopping cart, multiple payment options, secure checkout, and simplified checkout for returning customers. ([dorsetwaxandwicks.co.uk](https://dorsetwaxandwicks.co.uk/pages/app?utm_source=openai))

For navigation, one candle-app usability case found that a visible bottom navigation bar worked better than a hidden dropdown menu. The same case included order history and reordering; another candle app highlights loyalty rewards and app-only offers. ([sarahross.ca](https://www.sarahross.ca/work/good-vibes?utm_source=openai))
